proposal.description: reg_file's SCR latch status bit takes the synchronised but undebounced latch_stat instead of the debounced copy the supervisor acts on
proposal.reason: If latch_stat glitches high for less than the 1 ms assert qualification, a host read of the status register shows the latch as set even though the supervisor never saw it. A real latch release also shows up 200 us before the supervisor acts on it, so telemetry no longer matches what the supervisor is acting on.

proposal.description: reg_file's enable-switch status bit is fed the switch-press edge pulse en_switch_rise instead of the debounced switch level
proposal.reason: While the switch is held on, a host read of the status register shows the enable switch as off. It reads as on only during the single clock after a debounced press.

proposal.description: fault_LED's latch indication is fed the synchronised but undebounced SCR read-back instead of the debounced copy
proposal.reason: A latch_stat pulse shorter than the 1 ms assert qualification lights Red_LED1 solid even though the supervisor ignores it. A real latch also shows on Red_LED1 up to 1 ms before the supervisor shuts down.

proposal.description: The latch read-back debouncer is given the enable's fail-safe-low reset value, so the SCR latch reads clear out of reset although its synchroniser resets high
proposal.reason: If the SCR is still latched when reset is released, Red_LED1 and the latch status bit stay off for the first 1 ms instead of showing the latch at once. If the pin is low, the 200 us of latched indication that follows reset is missing.

proposal.description: The OTP debouncer's asymmetry is reversed: 200 us to assert and 1 ms to release, the 'trip fast, clear slow' habit applied where the design wants assert to be the longer qualification
proposal.reason: An OTP_trig pulse between 200 us and 1 ms long now shuts the converter down (En falls, Red_LED2 lights), when it should be rejected. Recovery after over-temperature clears is also delayed from 200 us to 1 ms.

proposal.description: The MOSI glitch filter is instanced with the fault-flag debounce times (1 ms high, 200 us low) instead of the short symmetric SPI_FILTER_CLKS, so it no longer matches the SCK filter
proposal.reason: At 1 MHz SCK no MOSI bit is held for 1 ms, so every bit spi_slave shifts in reads as 0. Every command fails its CRC: host writes to CONTROL and the limit registers are discarded, and reads return the wrong register or nothing.

proposal.description: pgood_gen takes the raw asynchronous PGOOD_comp pin instead of its synchronised copy, breaking the rule that no submodule sees a raw pin
proposal.reason: In S_RUN, PGOOD and switch_supply drop on the clock after PGOOD_comp falls instead of after the two-flop synchroniser delay. Qualification also starts on the unsynchronised level, so PGOOD asserts two clocks earlier.

why: make lint already catches it: make lint: UNUSEDSIGNAL
